newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 295 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 295 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 295 contracts compared to 420 contracts a day earlier, according to the CBOT.
There were 31 wheat, 70 corn, 123 soybean and 71 soymeal futures contracts. Options volume was nil.
Corn was 1/4 to 3/4 cent per bushel lower, wheat 1-1/4 cents higher, soybeans up one to down two cents, and soymeal down 40 cents to up 20 cents a ton.
